title: Animations
description: The app's Lottie and Rive files for the lottie-and-rive checker (check-animations): where they live, the budgets every file stays inside, and one record per file with its runtime, job, budget, reduced-motion alternative, licence and source.

assetsDir.description: Repo-relative folder of bundled assets, scanned for Lottie .json files (default assets). .riv and .lottie files are found anywhere in the repo.

wrapperFiles.description: Globs of the only files that may import lottie-react-native or @rive-app/react-native (default: the ui folder's animation/**). One of them calls useReduceMotion().

budgets.description: The app's ceilings. Each may be stricter than the library's (maxBytes 500000, heavyFromBytes 150000, maxFps 60, maxPlays 3, maxSeconds 10), never looser.

maxBytes.description: Largest file any record may budget, in bytes.

heavyFromBytes.description: A file this large or larger is heavy: its record says "heavy": true and it plays alone.

maxFps.description: Highest frame rate a file may be authored at (Lottie fr) or render at (Rive frameRate).

maxPlays.description: Most plays a bounded Lottie loop may take in one run.

maxSeconds.description: Longest a Lottie run may last: its length times its plays.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the bundled file, for example assets/animations/list-completed.json. Never a URL.

job.description: lottie: one-shot or loop; rive: state-machine.

maxBytes.description: This file's size budget in bytes, at most budgets.maxBytes.

fps.description: Lottie: the file's own frame rate (fr). Rive: the frameRate the app renders it at.

plays.description: Lottie only: plays per run, 1 for a one-shot, at most budgets.maxPlays for a loop.

stateMachine.description: Rive only: the state machine the app plays.

settles.description: Rive only: true once the designer confirmed every state rests (no endless timeline in an idle state).

heavy.description: Full-screen, large or costly: plays alone (AnimationStageProvider).

decorative.description: True when the art carries no information: hidden from VoiceOver and TalkBack.

reducedMotion.description: What Reduce Motion (and a test build held still) shows. frame: Lottie at progress (0 to 1), Rive paused on its first frame. hidden: nothing, for decorative art only.

licence.description: The licence the file is used under, for example the Lottie Simple License, CC0-1.0, or 'commissioned, all rights to the app'.

source.description: Where it came from: the page it was downloaded from, the vendor, or 'made by the team'.

author.description: The designer or studio, when the licence asks for credit.
